question: Who among the following was conferred the title of 'Global Visionary of Sustainable Business and Peace' in 2020 by the Federation of Israel Chambers of Commerce for epitomising 'unity, peace and sustainability?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ratan Tata**__.

__
 
• **Veteran industrialist Ratan Tata was conferred with the title of "Global Visionary of Sustainable Trade and Peace" by the Federation of Indo-Israel Chambers of Commerce (FIICC) for his symbol of "Unity, Peace and Stability"**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ratan Tata** is an Indian industrialist, philanthropist and former chairman of **Tata Sons**.

 
 
• He was also chairman of the Tata Group from 1990 to 2012, and again, as interim chairman from October 2016 to February 2017, and continues to head its charitable trusts.
 
• He is the recipient of two of India's highest civilian awards, the **Padma Vibhushan (2008) and the Padma Bhushan (2000)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani** is an Indian billionaire businessman, chairman, managing director and largest shareholder of **Reliance Industries Limited**.
 
• **Azim Hashim Premji **is an Indian businessman, investor, engineer and philanthropist who was the chairman of **Wipro Limited**. Premji continues to be a non-executive member and founding chairman of the board.
 
 
• He is informally known as the Czar of the Indian IT Industry.
 
 
 
• **Lakshmi Niwas Mittal** is an Indian steel magnate based in the United Kingdom.
 
 
• He is the executive chairman of **Arcelor Mittal****, the world's largest steelmaker**, as well as the chairman of stainless steel maker Aprum.
